name: 62052 · Jerseyville, IL
findings: ZIP 62052 (Jerseyville) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 21 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 62052 (Jerseyville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
38% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 62052 (Jerseyville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 19 organizations here; 46% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
